text: The experience has improved my mental health a lot, mainly by showing me that I don't have to live in a constant state of stress. I used to have frequent headaches, stomach problems and trouble sleeping, and I thought that was just normal life for someone with my job. After the experience I realised how much my body and mind were suffering. Since changing my habits and eventually my job, my anxiety has gone down, my sleep is better and I'm much happier overall. I also appreciate simple things more now, like having dinner with my partner without checking my phone, or reading a book on a Sunday afternoon. I feel like I have my life back.

Ich bin selbstbewusster und weniger ängstlich geworden. Ich habe weniger Angst davor, anderen Menschen zu missfallen, und kann deshalb ehrlicher sein. Das hat mein Wohlbefinden deutlich gesteigert, ich fühle mich freier und zufriedener in meinem Job und in meinen Beziehungen.

My anxiety has improved, because I understand where it comes from. I'm less dramatic about things, and I feel calmer. I also appreciate my mother more, oddly, because I see that she was anxious too and didn't know any better. That made me feel more compassion for her and for myself.
Way happier, way less anxious

Die Erfahrung hat mir ein tiefes Gefühl von Geborgenheit gegeben, das ich vorher nicht kannte. Ich hatte lange mit Ängsten und einer leichten Depression zu kämpfen, vor allem nach dem Tod meines Vaters. In der Erfahrung habe ich eine unglaubliche Liebe gespürt, die mich umgeben hat, und das Gefühl, dass ich nie wirklich allein bin. Seitdem bin ich deutlich weniger ängstlich, und meine Stimmung hat sich stabilisiert. Ich bin auch offener für spirituelle Fragen geworden und lese viel darüber, was ich früher abgelehnt hätte. Ich empfinde mehr Dankbarkeit für mein Leben und für die Menschen, die mir nahestehen, und ich nehme mir mehr Zeit für sie. Insgesamt bin ich ein zufriedenerer Mensch.

I'm calmer and more mindful. I enjoy the present moment more, and I don't feel so rushed and anxious all the time. My mental health has definitely improved, and I think I'm more pleasant to be around.
I'd say no impact really

Ich bin psychisch stabiler geworden, weil ich mir selbst mehr erlaube. Ich darf schwach sein, ich darf traurig sein, ich darf um Hilfe bitten. Das hat mir sehr viel Druck genommen. Früher hatte ich regelmäßig depressive Einbrüche, vor allem im Winter, und habe mich dann monatelang durch den Alltag geschleppt. Seit der Erfahrung sind diese Phasen deutlich milder. Ich verstehe auch besser, warum ich so lange geglaubt habe, immer stark sein zu müssen. Das hat mit meiner Kindheit zu tun, als meine Mutter krank war und ich mich um alles kümmern musste. Mit diesem Verständnis kann ich freundlicher mit mir umgehen, und meine Ehe ist auch inniger geworden, weil ich mich meinem Mann mehr öffne.

My anxiety has decreased significantly. I used to have a lot of social anxiety and performance anxiety, and it limited my career and my social life. Now I can present at work and go to parties without feeling sick. I'm more open to new experiences, and I've become more curious about the people around me, instead of being so focused on how I come across.
Less anxious, more balanced overall

Ich bin weniger gestresst und habe mehr Freude an meinen Kindern. Ich genieße die Zeit mit ihnen mehr und bin nicht mehr so perfektionistisch. Das hat auch meine Stimmung verbessert, ich bin einfach fröhlicher.

The impact on my mental health has been profound. I think the most important thing is that I feel a deep sense of gratitude and love that wasn't there before. I'd been through a lot of hard things in my life, and I'd become quite bitter and cynical. During the experience, when I saw my whole life passing before me, I also saw how much love there had been in it, from my grandparents, my teachers, my friends, my partner. I'd been so focused on the bad things that I'd completely missed all the good. I cried for a long time, mostly out of gratitude. Since then, I try to notice the love and the good things every day. I keep a gratitude journal, which I would have found ridiculous before. My mood is much better, I'm less irritable, and I feel more connected to the people in my life. When my father died, I was sad, but I was also grateful for the time we had, and that made the grief easier to bear.
I'm more confident and less anxious. I feel more like myself.
Keinen nennenswerten Einfluss.

My mental health has improved because I'm not constantly carrying the weight of everything I've been avoiding. I used to have a background anxiety all the time, and I didn't know where it came from. After I started dealing with things, it lifted. I'm calmer, I sleep better and I'm more productive. I also feel more open to life in general, more willing to try new things.

Negatively, I now get moments of derealisation, mostly when I'm very stressed or tired. It scared me a lot at first. I've learned to manage it better but it hasn't gone away completely and it's been three years.

Ich bin selbstbewusster geworden und habe das Gefühl, dass ich mich besser kenne. Das hat meiner psychischen Gesundheit gutgetan. Ich bin weniger unsicher und fühle mich wohler in meiner Haut. Ich treffe auch Entscheidungen leichter, weil ich weiß, was ich will.

I'm less anxious and depressed. Being a calmer parent has made me happier too, and I appreciate my son for who he is now instead of wishing he were different. I see so much beauty in him that I couldn't see before because I was always stressed.

I would say the experience has been the beginning of healing for me. I've had depression and anxiety for most of my life, and nothing really helped, not medication, not years of therapy. The experience gave me a feeling of being loved and safe that I had never felt before. It's hard to describe how big that was. Since then, my depression has been much more manageable. I still have bad days, but I don't feel the bottomless despair that I used to feel. I'm also more open to connection. I've made a few close friends and I'm in a relationship for the first time in years. I understand myself better, especially how my childhood affected me, and I'm much gentler with myself.
Etwas zufriedener

I feel less lonely and more supported, and that has had a big effect on my mental health. My depression has lifted quite a bit. I'm also more open with my emotions, which was something I really struggled with as a man. The men's group has been great for this. We talk about things I never would have talked about before.
I don't really care about my career anymore. I'm not depressed or anything, it's just stopped mattering. I go to work and come home.
Ich habe weniger depressive Gedanken und bin nicht mehr so streng mit mir. Insgesamt geht es mir besser als vor der Erfahrung.
More flexible and open minded. I don't need things to be a certain way to be happy anymore.
Probably none. It was fun though.

Ich bin fröhlicher und unbeschwerter geworden. Ich nehme mich und das Leben nicht mehr so ernst. Das hat mir psychisch sehr gutgetan, ich lache mehr, ich bin entspannter, und ich genieße die schönen Momente bewusster. Ich habe auch das Gefühl, dass ich mehr Liebe für die Menschen um mich herum empfinde, und meine Freundschaften sind tiefer geworden.

I feel more connected to nature and that makes me happier. I'm more aware of how much I need it, and I'm grateful for it. I appreciate the changing seasons and the small details, like the first spring flowers.

My panic disorder has improved a lot. I had panic attacks several times a week, and now it's maybe once a month, and they're less intense. I'm not afraid of them anymore, which takes away so much of their power. I also feel more free to live my life, I travel, I go to concerts, I take the subway, all things I avoided before.
Ich grüble weniger und bin positiver eingestellt.
I'm less angry and resentful, and I feel more peace in my relationships. My mood is generally better.

Understanding that I'm highly sensitive has been life-changing for my mental health. I used to think something was wrong with me because I got overwhelmed so easily. I had burnouts twice. Now I know how I work, and I can plan my life accordingly. I'm less exhausted, less anxious and I have more energy for things I enjoy. I also have more self-acceptance. I used to try to be like everyone else, and now I accept that I'm different, and that it's okay. I've even started to see my sensitivity as a strength, because it lets me feel things deeply, like music and art and nature, and I appreciate those things so much more now.
Ich bin innerlich ruhiger und ausgeglichener. Mir geht es psychisch besser als vor der Erfahrung, vor allem, weil ich mich nicht mehr so viel ärgere. Ich habe auch mehr Geduld mit meiner Familie.
Same as before, nothing to report

I feel more emotionally stable and mature. I used to have big mood swings, and I'd get depressed whenever something went wrong. Now I'm more even, and I can handle disappointment without falling apart. I understand myself better too, especially my tendency to blame others when I feel insecure. That self-understanding has made me a better partner and friend, and I think it's improved my mental health a lot. I also have more empathy for people, I'm more curious about their perspectives.
Ich achte besser auf mich und meine Grenzen, und dadurch geht es mir psychisch deutlich besser. Ich habe keine Erschöpfungszustände mehr wie früher und bin insgesamt zufriedener.
I'm more optimistic and I feel more trust in life. My anxiety has gone way down.

My mental health has improved because I'm less avoidant. I used to have a lot of hidden anxiety and depression that I covered up with constant distraction. Now that I let myself feel things, I can actually process them, and they don't build up anymore. I feel lighter and more alive. I also appreciate quiet moments more, which I used to fill up with noise. Sometimes I just sit on my balcony and watch the sky, and that makes me happy in a way I never knew before.
Nach der Erfahrung ging es mir eine Zeit lang schlechter, ich war ängstlicher und hatte Schlafprobleme. Inzwischen ist es wieder wie vorher, eine positive Wirkung kann ich nicht feststellen.
I like myself more. That's the biggest change and it has made everything else better.

I feel a lot less lonely and much more connected to the people around me. That has improved my mental health more than anything else. I used to have periods of deep loneliness and depression, and those have become much rarer. I feel loved and I feel like I belong, which I didn't before. I've also become more open and curious about people.
